title: Australian Dollar softens on hawkish Fed outlook
summary: The AUD/USD pair loses ground to near 0.7115 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) as the Federal Reserve (Fed) raised interest rates to 3.75%–4.00% and hinted at further hikes before year-end.
